summary: Implementation plan for mobile-only accordion drawer architecture for the carousel / practice slides view. Details state management (defaulting to Chapter 01 open, single-open accordion behavior), drawer header styling with Liam's editorial typography ([01 / 06] • HOW WE WORK), collapsible content animation via Framer Motion, smooth auto-scroll to the active drawer, and preservation of desktop views and the 6 clinical chapters with zero photography.
